description: Guest asks for parking for more than one car or additional parking. Real response directs to paid parking at 192-234 Vaughan Street.
guestMessage: We have two cars. Is there anywhere else we can park nearby?

context.suggestedResponseSnippet: We only have on-site parking for one car. For paid parking, we have 192-234 Vaughan Street Parking nearby. The alternative is to find street parking in the area, usually towards the Western Promenade. I recommend using the SpotHero application, where you can book in advance and get cheaper rates.

notes: Real specific parking recommendation from old code for additional vehicles.
